steps.content:
█ Number: MBCC-SS-000-0807114
█ File: Follow-up Investigation Report on Sinner 000

*Annex: Background Details

...
Sinner 000's parents died in N.F. 108. She was later adopted by the leader of the Eastside underground organization "Noir" under a fake identity.

Between N.F. 108 and 112, the organization exploited 000's hacking skills to generate illegal profits.

These activities include, but were not limited to, attacking private websites, stealing personal information, and embezzling digital assets.

After the dark web appeared in N.F. 112, Noir's criminal activities increased exponentially, and the exploitation of technicians like 000 intensified.

From N.F. 112 through early 114, they amassed approximately 150 million DisCoins through various illegal means.
In February, N.F. 114, Sinner 000 left the organization for unknown reasons. The team, without its core technician, quickly declined, leading to Noir's rapid collapse.
[Scene transition, cell door]
The summary meeting ends. Two employees talked in hushed tones as they leave the conference room.

steps.speaker: Employee B
steps.content: ...Have you seen the report? All the victims have been rescued except...

steps.speaker: Employee B
steps.content: Those people who were rescued... I can't imagine what they went through...

steps.speaker: Employee A
steps.content: It's over now, anyways... The case has been handed over to the Public Security Bureau. They will handle it.

steps.speaker: Employee B
steps.content: All right... The Sinner detained recently seems to also be a victim of Noir. I wonder...
Their voices grow softer, finally fading into sighs.
000 leans against the end of the corridor, seemingly having just pulled off another prank. Two employees walk past her, then turn back to comfort her and slip her some candy.
Seeing what they gave her, 000's smile vanishes. She pushes the sweets back and turns away.
You witness everything from the other end of the corridor.
The matter of 000 is not strictly confidential, and many employees involved in the operation have seen the investigation report.

What was written in the report saddens them. They sympathize with her experience and pity her past. Almost everyone has shown some goodwill towards 000; watching out for her, tolerating her pranks, and even directly comforting her.
However, their goodwill doesn't seem to have reaped good results. Dazed in the first place, now 000 seems to have grown irritable.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Chief, the operation follow-up report is ready.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We have conducted physical and psychological assessments for all the victims, and the results are not good. Some victims are severely traumatized, making treatment difficult and recovery potentially long.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Those victims have all been transferred to the city hospital, but...
Nightingale shakes her head.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Got it. Leave the rest to me.
[Scene transition, in front of the Sinner's room]
You stop in front of 000's room.
The door is open, and you see her sitting with her back to the door. You hear nothing but the buzz of the fluorescent light.
Not turning around, she just lets out a curt sigh.
...What's this?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: All the recent dispatch missions. Quite the stack.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Freeloading will get you punished publicly. Are you sure you're okay with that?
...Doesn't matter. I don't care.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Oh? Then I guess I'll have to send out this Noir dispatch along with the preliminary investigation...
You...
000 suddenly turns back to you. Seeing that you didn't even move, she realizes that you tricked her.
You push the stack of documents towards 000, revealing the investigation report underneath.

options: It's not that you don't care about your past.

choices.text: It's not that you don't care about your past.

steps.content: Quite the opposite, actually. 000 rejects those who pry into her past, so strongly that it confuses those people.
It's not out of spite or pain. Her resistance isn't projected outward but turns into deep bewilderment and confusion... ultimately falling back on herself.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: There must be something more that troubles you, besides this organization. What happened in the past? What are you grappling with?
000 remains motionless. Her face is shrouded in shadows, making her expression unreadable.
After a long while, she finally chuckles softly.
Huh... You want to say you're different, that you understand and care about me, so I should tell you everything and, through you, embrace myself again?
Alright, then let's talk.
000 suddenly tilts her head up, staring straight into your eyes.
The vengeful tragedies of a hero with a dark past marching towards freedom... let your imagination run wild.
Honestly, there's not much to say... I don't have unresolved issues to hide. My experiences and "inner journey" are far less exciting than what you imagine.
She smiles, but her eyes are ice-cold. She moves closer to you, her equally icy hand gently caressing your cheek.
Anyways, I've finished my journey without feeling a thing.

Yes, my parents were murdered, and my life is extremely tragic. I'm so pitiful that anyone who sees me feels heartbroken and wants to shield and help me. They all plead with me not to be blinded by vengeance, saying that my family would never want me to fall into the evil abyss.
"Oh... so in this situation, I should be consumed by rage, thinking only of vengeance even at the cost of my life, to kill that villain to avenge my grief? Alrighty then."
Her tone is exaggerated and pretentious. Like an actress on stage, she speaks of her past as if recounting someone else's story.

So I killed him, no messing. That night, the good folks hugged me, crying with mixed emotions. My vengeful companions laughed, pulling the trigger on themselves to reunite with their deceased families... oh, yes, it was pouring rain. Quite the scene, really.

But what about me? I felt nothing. Relief? Sadness? Empty? Ha, none of it. When I avenged my parents, I couldn't even remember the murderer's face... Apart from inexplicably awakening as a Sinner, nothing in my life changed.

Is this a characteristic of Sinners? No, that's not right. When your Sinners awaken, they either feel profound pain, sudden enlightenment, or intense desire... Ha, I'm the only one who is this muddled and unclear.
The sense of dissonance intensifies, almost suffocating you. She lowers her head. Her emotionlessness makes you stay, and her questions sound like accusations.
Am I filming some movie? A huge set, with only me as the lousy actor... holding the protagonist's script but unable to fit into the role?
Is my memory playing tricks on me? Like in those sci-fi films... 000 is just a robot, with fabricated memories and emotions implanted into her brain, so her dullness and indifference aren't wrong?

Or perhaps the truth is: the entire world is just a fabricated game, and the real me is just a brain in a vat, a test subject... Haha, maybe someone is still watching through the monitors, waiting for my performance?
She laughs for quite a while. Then, her smile freezes and fades away, leaving only exhaustion and emptiness in her eyes.
...Or perhaps, nothing's wrong with the world. My life is fine, and all of you are right... I'm the abnormal one.

Unable to have normal emotions, unable to connect with anyone, unable to cherish my own life, so of course I can't do anything that's expected of me. The world is so big, yet I feel separated from it by a barrier. I'm not living the right way. I'm the error.
Haha... hahaha... I'm unable to live the right way, so I'm the biggest error...
000 is still caressing your cheek. Her grip lightens, but you remain frozen and unable to break free.
The smile she used as a mask begins to crack, fragmenting, revealing the true soul within...
Just like 000's words, she's empty inside. There's nothing there.
This is the real issue you've overlooked. 000 doesn't need sympathy or care... From the beginning, she never accepted <color=#fb9259>the person she is now</color>.
The girl before you overlaps with the figure in your memory, only to be torn apart by reality. You finally refocus on 000's tearful face.
Or are you using those eyes...
...to see someone else's shadow in me?
The seal on your memory is shattered by the impact of emotions. Fragments pour out from the rift, filling your mind.

The person in your memory... always holds her head high, proudly facing all that is predetermined without yielding. No matter how the world changes, she would never deny the meaning of her existence, no matter how slim the odds.
You once thought she might be <color=#fb9259>that person</color>, so she would also, like <color=#fb9259>that person</color>, never feel defeated by any fate.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>real 000</color> is completely gone.
The smile on the girl's face freezes and then fades away. She slowly lets go of your hand.
FAC Captain
Haha...
Hahahahaha! Are you going to cry now? Haha, you look like a child who lost their toy. How embarrassing. Is this really the MBCC Chief?
Everyone loves you, and you love everyone. You're ready to do great things. Look, you got the best role, the most exciting script...
Don't shed tears for an error like me. Stop making that face. Don't let me affect you. Come now, don't cry. Let me wipe your face for you.
The girl giggles wildly. She tries to wipe your eyes and cheeks, but when she touches your face, she feels nothing but dryness—You are not the one crying.
Huh? How could this...?
Tears are flowing, but they are 000's.
How ridiculous... Why am I crying...
Please stop... No, please...
...So strange... why am I...
Tears keep falling.
The next second, the world changes.
Her tears rip open the space wherever they land, revealing a chaotic and twisted phantom realm. Familiar yet strange scenes flood your mind. More and more memories that shouldn't exist resurface.
You look at the girl named 000. She looks at you with the same confusion and astonishment, her eyes brimming with tears.
The space begins to disintegrate. A chaotic storm emerges from the void, entangling your body.
An invisible force grabs you as the ground disappears beneath your feet. Your body cannot react, and you can only watch yourself being pulled into the void.
Take my hand!
At the last moment, the girl thrusts her hand out to you.
But just before your fingers touch, the rift in the space closes, and the darkness swallows you whole.
